originalReplay.method: Simultaneous baseline-runtime and repo current simulation replay of all 763 consumed input entries. Compare JSON-normalized complete state each tick, excluding only top-level scoring/result and stats.score. Separately reconstruct the browser pilot at every one of 742 historical observation ticks and compare every requested field with numeric tolerance1e-7. Compare replay terminal physical fields with original browser evidence.

lateralContinuation.note: One scratch candidate. Exact consumed CI38 inputs until dodge acceptance7837. Generated pilot thereafter uses original request/acceptance ticks through7885, then repeats recorded request/acceptance cadence. Steering delivery at acceptance; keyboard/fire/throttle one tick later. Modeled Node continuation, not browser acceptance or an exact unrecorded run.
lateralContinuation.candidate: Normal && !canDescend && relative.y>=0 && altitude>230 => full lateral turn away from relative horizontal side, climb0; other dodge branches unchanged

scope: Only the external test pilot changes. Product flight, collision, AI, weapons and HP remain unchanged. Modeled Node continuation is not browser or human playability evidence.
